dominant_strengths: Warm amber accent against near-black creates a moody, focused atmosphere distinct from typical blue-tinted palettes.
Clear information hierarchy with grouped sections (Recently Used, Actions), tag chips, and footer hint row.
Restrained iconography and consistent row rhythm make scanning fast and behaviorally predictable.
dominant_weaknesses: Section labels and footer hints are too dim, hovering near unreadable on the dark canvas, hurting legibility.
Tag chips (file, nav, view, tasks) feel inconsistent in semantics and weight—some categorize, some duplicate icons.
Concept is a familiar Raycast/Linear archetype with little novel mechanic beyond the amber tint and selection glow.
fix_priorities: Raise contrast on muted labels (RECENTLY USED, footer keys) to at least WCAG AA for dark UI.
Rationalize chip taxonomy: pick either category tags or shortcut hints, not a mixed system.
Introduce a signature interaction (preview pane, fuzzy match highlights, or contextual breadcrumb) to earn distinctiveness.
Strengthen selected-row treatment with a clearer left rail or subtle gradient instead of faint orange line.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral warmth lands well and behavior is solid, but reflective payoff is thin because it reads as a competent clone rather than a memorable tool.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it functions clearly as a command palette and the 'improved' framing shows in polish, though the improvements are incremental rather than conceptual.
